bio: A restaurant that has made a name for itself in the Arán valley! Here, the modern-inspired cooking is a surprising combination of locally sourced seasonal ingredients and Asian and Spanish-American flavours. It offers an à la carte-style menu entitled Er Occitan (on which you can choose an appetiser, starter, main course and dessert) plus a more extensive surprise tasting menu. One dish we can particularly recommend is the organic Berry green lentils with Vadouvan curry, pigeon and coconut....
